statements.status_notes: Affects distribution registry blob storage when storage.cache.blobdescriptor uses redis and storage.delete.enabled is true, allowing revoked repo-local reads to return after peer-repo activity. This image does not run a distribution registry or that redis-backed storage backend.

Affects distribution registry pull-through cache proxy auth when an operator configures an upstream registry; credentials can be sent to an attacker-controlled realm URL. This image runs only the argocd-image-updater controller, which uses distribution/v3 as a client library and does not run a distribution registry or that proxy flow.
